'Keep wrappers' implies same names/signatures; all gate helpers return bool or dict (no exceptions/error messages raised), so behavior is evident from operations.py:1625-2258.

Ambiguous abbreviations unspecified. Fix: resolve candidate via `git rev-parse --verify <sha>^{commit}` (fails on ambiguous) then `git merge-base --is-ancestor <full-sha> HEAD`; treat ambiguity as rejection.
Already stated: goal requires a hash that 'is an ancestor of HEAD', so a valid non-ancestor full hash is rejected.
Existing gate already rejects on git-absent (FileNotFoundError->False) and non-repo/no-HEAD (nonzero rev-parse): operations.py:2242-2256.
Ancestry check rejects non-commit objects; a tag/blob sha is not an ancestor of HEAD, so it fails regardless of the hex regex.
'path under tests/' means prefix tests/, so nested paths like tests/unit/test_x.py are accepted.

Spec omits suffix rule. Fix: state requirement that the resolved path has .py suffix and lives under tests/ (or a node id whose path part does), matching current _reference_points_to_test: operations.py:2221-2240.

'optionally ::node' leaves validation depth unset; current code strips ::node and checks only path existence (operations.py:2236-2239), so tests/test_x.py::NotARealTest passes. Fix: state node ids are not validated, or validate via pytest --collect-only.
Absolute paths, '..', symlinks, case unset. Fix: require the resolved path be inside <root>/tests; reject absolute and '..'-escaping paths.
Current semantics: each reference is tested by independent matchers (operations.py:1625-1638), each gate passes with >=1 matching ref, and verify_task_closeout ANDs tests+link+commit (:1608-1623).
Existing helper _make_repo builds a temp git repo with one commit (tests/test_closeout.py:25-34); a non-ancestor hash is obtained by adding a second commit.
